review_snapshot.rule: This disposition is valid only while the Current node-shard manifest retains the same canonical row digest. Source change reopens compact review rather than silently inheriting this approval.

review_rule: Chengfeng remains the continuous first-round semantic mainline. Canonical Xi priorities control closure depth: P0/P1 high-value identities, role structures and confusable boundaries must be represented; P2 may remain source-primary/deferred. Suyi may supply compact exact-list recovery or past-exam/framework cross-check when Current Chengfeng ownership is clear but a stable child enumeration is not conveniently projected. It never becomes a second learner course.

chengfeng_review.boundary: All canonical Xi Natural Units remain source-bound. The fresh review attacked every chapter and restored the high-value P0/P1 semantics needed by the present first-round path. P2 units are intentionally allowed to remain source-primary unless their boundary is needed to keep the chapter semantically true. Closure does not require duplicating every child node or long normative formulation.

suyi_delta_review.other_use: Declared Suyi refs in chapter assets are framework/past-exam cross-checks or duplicate support unless explicitly listed above.

priority_boundary.P0: Must preserve high-value fixed structures/boundaries in Current learner backend.
priority_boundary.P1: Preserve exam-relevant identity/boundary/role semantics without forcing permanent recall.
priority_boundary.P2: May remain source-primary/deferred; do not promote simply to make the asset look exhaustive.

precision_boundary: Long meeting/date timelines, dense policy deployment lists and low-discrimination normative wording remain Chengfeng-primary unless evidence activates them.
C02 exact list structure is represented, but downstream explanatory prose remains source-primary.
P2 units remain canonical and represented; their existence does not imply active recall or full backend duplication.
No exact wording is manufactured from model memory when Current source is noisy or incomplete.
acceptance_boundary: Xi content closure means Current C00-C17 represents all canonical Natural Units and contains the high-value P0/P1 identities, relations, fixed structures and confusable boundaries needed for the present first-round path. It does not mean every Chengfeng line is duplicated, every P2 item is active, L/P/R/E are accepted, or Kian has learned the subject.
